title: Jeffrey Jones
description: Departing from GALAXY tradition, artist Jeff Jones chose to depict the exterior of Yoda's little hut-like home on Dagobah: "It was one of the most interesting environments presented in the STAR WARS saga." Since 1967, the admired and prolific Jones has been both a comics professional and a book cover artist, with an occasional movie poster job like DRAGONSLAYER thrown in for good measure. He's worked for Warren, DC, Last Gasp, Pacific, King, Gold Key, NATIONAL LAMPOON ("Idyl") and HEAVY METAL ("I'm Age"). Recently, the Friedlander Group published a trading card set based on his fantasy renderings.
